A full card image with the corrected text set into the card and a small bronze disc at the bottom right, marking it as errata. The Players Committee showed it in its online card lists; the earliest saved copy is from 1 August 2022. Disc images of other cards were saved from May 2013, so this image may be older than its first saved copy.

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:JP-L-leslomytacema-PC-Errata-2022-disc-card-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Leslomy Tacema (PC Errata 2018 E card)]] (8 July 2018): Same words as the previous version. Another full card image (347 × 488 pixels): the text box is set again, and a small round bronze disc at the lower right replaces the white “E”.

The whole 2018 E card image and the whole 2022 disc card image, both scaled to 500 pixels wide; nothing else is edited.
